manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0106; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: I live near here and I live near the school are natural A1 residence statements.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy preserves live as «زندگی کردن/ساکن بودن».

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: I work near here is a plausible same-frame semantic contrast.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both learner responses use a familiar I + verb + location frame.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response replaces a general nearby location with a specific landmark.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target sense, translations and retrieval align.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 residence sense of live.
